note: The site lists one vitola, 'Rothschild' (4.5x50), with no wrapper specified. Research strongly suggests this unqualified listing is the original/base Mexican San Andres (maduro) blend, which is the same wrapper as the Mac's photos labeled 'Maduro' - so no new vitola is added for that variant, just this note. The Connecticut-wrapper edition, however, is a confirmed genuinely separate 2016 release and is added below. No source found lists any Rothchildes vitola beyond 4.5x50 in any wrapper.

additional_vitolas.name: Connecticut
additional_vitolas.notes: Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper, debuted at 2016 IPCPR.
